chunks: And the stars and the trees prostrate (to Him).

key_terms.النَّجْمُ: The star(s), referring to celestial bodies
key_terms.يَسْجُدَانِ: They two prostrate (dual form), indicating the act of worship/submission

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says stars and trees prostrate?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ontological submission (taslim) of all creation, where stars and trees prostrate not merely by physical movement but through adherence to their divine laws. This universal worship serves as a precursor to the final verse of the Surah, emphasizing that all beings, animate and inanimate, acknowledge Allah's sovereignty in their own distinct manner.
